author: driver
content:
Additional task: the SECT dump contains what appear to be Ghidra type library programs (not binaries): PspSvcIf, PspHw, PspSev, CcpIf, SecOS, ArXbShared, TE, VMSA, TrustedOsInterface. These likely contain PSP_STATUS enum, SVC call numbers, CCP descriptor structs, etc.

Plan:
1. Run ListDataTypes.java on PspSvcIf and PspHw to discover available types
2. Write ApplyPspTypes.java that copies relevant enums/structs from these programs into the zen2 programs
3. Where functions return PSP_STATUS, retype their return value
4. Apply CcpIf types to CCP MMIO access sites
